        out.close();
    }

    static class Unstoppable {
        public void solve(Scanner in, PrintWriter out) {
            int n = in.nextInt();
            long b = in.nextLong();

            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                a[i] = in.nextInt();
                if (a[i] % 2 == 0) c[i] = 1;
                else c[i] = -1;
            }
            long sum = 0;

            for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; i++) {
                sum += c[i];

                    array.add(Math.abs(a[i] - a[i + 1]));
                }
            }
            sum = 0;
            int count = 0;
            Collections.sort(array);
            for (int i = 0; i < array.size(); i++) {
                sum += array.get(i);
                if (sum <= b) count++; else break;
            }
            out.println(count);
        }
    }

    static class InputReader {
        public Scanner scanner;

        public InputReader(InputStream stream) {
            scanner = new Scanner(stream);
        }

        public String next() {
            return scanner.next();
        }

        public long nextLong() {
            return scanner.nextLong();
        }

        public int nextInt() {
            return scanner.nextInt();
        }
    }
}
